thesis: PGNY re-rated on Q3 results (14% gap from 30.10 to 34.37 on 2.8M shares) and has held a tight 34.94-37.21 consolidation on lighter volume, with accelerating revenue (YoY 1.4% to 5.3% to 8.9%) and net income growth, low dilution risk and forward P/E 15.2. The premarket 36.08 is inside the 35.6-36.3 pullback zone, giving about 2.7 reward/risk to the 39.5 measured-move target against a 34.8 stop. This matches the post-earnings consolidation pattern noted in lessons, but the risk-off tape (VIX 31.19, QQQ below its 50/200-day) and overbought RSI 70.5 cap conviction, so the rating is Overweight rather than Buy.
